ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white central contiguous mass bounded by irregular black margins. The left lobe contains a vertical series of five distinct circular dark spots and a cluster of high-contrast black vertical striations on the outer tip. The right lobe contains one prominent circular dark spot in the center-right region and smaller dark flecks near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/4 the height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge. Notable large-scale jagged peaks on the inner right lobe and a significant deep rectangular indentation on the upper-left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lower visible boundaries exhibit smooth convexity, while the trailing edges follow an irregular, jagged trajectory terminating in distinct pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, raised, circular white and grey pixel groups (barnacle colonization) are visible on the extreme left and right terminal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal black linear disruptions (rake-like patterns) are visible on the mid-to-outer section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss or deep notch on the upper terminal edge of the left lobe, creating a non-continuous geometric break in the fluke's contour.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique constellation of circular dark spots on the left lobe and a single isolated large circular spot on the right lobe center.
